experiment.objective: Ablate only the discovery scan path: current Phase1 seven-point scan versus exact Q3_fast2 eight-point scan.
experiment.transport_and_clock: run_version patches only post to OfflineSimulator.post and sleep/time for deterministic virtual-time execution
experiment.stage_instrumentation: wrap the actual Q3_phase1.process_pending_channels call; actions before the call are scan_and_enroute and actions during it are postprocessing
experiment.stage_note: OfflineSimulator records accepted measure/clear actions and virtual time; stage boundary is the real main-to-process_pending transition.

strict_controls.channel_order: Q3_phase1.scan_channel_order: even scan index 1..20, odd scan index 20..1

experiment.runtime_mutation: Only Q3_phase1.SCAN_N, SCAN_R, SCAN_ANGLE_DEG are changed for the 8-point run and restored after each pair; no source implementation file was edited.
